title: Concentration Inequalities for Sample Cross-Covariances
abstract: This paper establishes sharp dimension-free concentration and expectation bounds for the deviation of a sample cross-covariance matrix from its mean. For sub-Gaussian random vectors, we prove a high-probability operator-norm bound governed by the effective ranks of the two marginal covariance matrices. In the Gaussian case, we prove a matching expectation lower bound, allowing arbitrary correlation between the two random vectors.
